message: I remember a camping trip where we were cooking dinner, and my buddy Jamie freaked out because the smoke alarm in the cabin went off. He was convinced we were going to end up in a fiery disaster! After a good laugh, we talked about how important it is to have a plan and know where the exits are in case of an actual emergency. Sometimes, it just takes a chill friend to remind you that preparing doesn’t have to be stressful—just smart. 😊
